title: Panchayat Season 5 trailer on 23 Nov (Prime Video promo, 22 Nov); season streams on Prime Video from 3 Dec
headline: Panchayat Season 5: Trailer on 23 Nov, Streaming From 3 Dec
caption:
Panchayat Season 5's trailer arrives on Monday, 23 November. Prime Video announced the date on Sunday in a new promo, ahead of the season's premiere on Thursday, 3 December, in India and more than 240 countries and territories.

In the promo, Banrakas (Durgesh Kumar) walks through a modernised, transformed Phulera and says, "Ab shuru hoga humara raaj!" Season 4 ended with Kranti Devi (Sunita Rajwar), backed by Banrakas, beating Manju Devi (Neena Gupta) in the panchayat election.

Jitendra Kumar returns as Abhishek Tripathi, the panchayat secretary. TVF produces the series and Deepak Kumar Mishra directs it.

Have you watched Panchayat yet?

Sources: Prime Video, India TV, Filmibeat, Esquire India, Outlook India
